evidencePolicy.governingRule: Printer Authority + UGO -> Governed Family -> Universal Zeroing Road. An authoritative printer or issuer statement governs that printer's product identity, face, purpose, configuration, and printed content. UGO must still prove the submitted image maps to the governed family geometry and orientation before directional authority is released.
evidencePolicy.unknownRule: A missing value is null and UNPROVEN; it is never copied from a visually similar product.
evidencePolicy.productRule: A publisher product and each exact face retain independent identity even when geometry is later proven reusable.
evidencePolicy.executionRule: Only an explicit GOVERNED targetProfileBinding may enter the universal zeroing capability.
evidencePolicy.printerAuthorityRule: When the printer or issuing authority identifies its own product, face, purpose, configuration, dimensions, or printed content, preserve and accept that statement with provenance; do not require a second artifact merely to re-prove it.
evidencePolicy.geometryReuseRule: A printer-authorized face may reuse governed family geometry when its runtime UGO registration proves the operative mapping and orientation. UGO proves the mapping; it does not re-litigate the printer's identity statement. Carrier size, raster scaling, publisher ink, and non-operative wording remain separately recorded facts.
evidencePolicy.materialityRule: Govern what can change the executable zeroing result; record without re-governing what cannot. UGO registration, orientation, source reconciliation, applicable mechanical authority, and completion authority remain fail closed.
evidencePolicy.knownIdentityRule: A known product or face with an unresolved execution fact is a known authority hold, never an unknown target and never a request for more photograph coverage unless coverage actually failed.
evidencePolicy.shooterStateRule: Runtime admission distinguishes UNKNOWN_TARGET, KNOWN_TARGET_GEOMETRY_AUTHORIZED, KNOWN_TARGET_AUTHORITY_UNRESOLVED, and KNOWN_TARGET_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED.

authorizationSweep.decision: One authority-floor sweep grouped every remaining face by reusable root cause. The preserved Army authority closes the shared M16A4 mechanical/procedure branch once, unlocking both GunFun reverse faces through the existing Standard M16A4/M4 family UGO and universal zeroing road. Sixteen faces remain held by nine explicit root authority gaps; redundant printer-identity, carrier-size, ink, and repeated family-fact gates are prohibited.

rootAuthorityGaps.whyUGOCannotExecute: UGO can prove image geometry and orientation, but cannot convert a 25-meter proxy result into a truthfully confirmed true-distance zero.

rootAuthorityGaps.sharedMissingAuthority: Course-specific subface geometry, scoring, procedure, and completion authority.
rootAuthorityGaps.whyUGOCannotExecute: These are qualification-course products, not interchangeable zeroing faces; the universal zeroing road cannot invent course scoring or completion.

rootAuthorityGaps.sharedMissingAuthority: A governed rule that resolves the printer's generic M16 face to the correct M16 generation/equipment branch after UGO.
rootAuthorityGaps.whyUGOCannotExecute: UGO can classify geometry, but generic 'M16' printer language does not by itself select M16A1, M16A2/A3, or M16A4 mechanics.

rootAuthorityGaps.sharedMissingAuthority: The exact M68 optic/mount branch, operative aim/offset mapping, and governed registration package.
rootAuthorityGaps.whyUGOCannotExecute: The product is known, but UGO cannot choose a device/mount offset or mechanics that the evidence does not identify.

rootAuthorityGaps.sharedMissingAuthority: A complete canonical M16A1 face registration and confirmation package tied to the 25m-to-250m procedure.
rootAuthorityGaps.whyUGOCannotExecute: Army evidence establishes identity, purpose, aim, and basic click displacement, but the current corpus lacks the executable face mapping and confirmation contract.

rootAuthorityGaps.sharedMissingAuthority: Complete issued symbol geometry and configuration-specific optic/laser/mount offset branches.
rootAuthorityGaps.whyUGOCannotExecute: This is a 10-meter boresight capability; UGO cannot infer device offsets or treat it as the 25-meter live-fire zero road.

scaleProofs.decision: One batch processed the full known catalog. Baker M4 inherits one new Standard M16A4/M4 family package; GunFun 82020 inherits the existing Standard M16A2/A3 package. Modern MOA faces remain one family-level true-distance-completion hold, and every other hold is reduced to one material identity, UGO, course, or mechanical boundary.

Printer or issuer authority establishes the six product/face identities and their M4 purpose. One shared family UGO mapping pattern proves each submitted photo's geometry and orientation at runtime; all six then inherit the existing Standard M4 family procedure, M4/M4A1 mechanical branch, confirmation authority, and universal zeroing road. The two remaining family faces are held only because M16A4 mechanics are not governed.

The 18-face batch collapsed to nine root authority gaps. Existing Army authority governs the M16A4 iron-sight branch once; GunFun 32110 red and 32120 green reverse faces preserve printer identity, use the shared 14 x 16 family UGO, and inherit the same family and universal road. No face-level mechanical package or zeroing road was created.
